hunks.sol: Hyuk Mujin tilted his head in confusion, then hurried after me. Hearing his footsteps behind me, I laughed softly.

hunks.baseline: The narrow gorge that had swallowed so many lives, and the clear chime that rang out amid the shower of falling petals.
hunks.sol: The narrow gorge that had swallowed so many lives, and the clear chime that rang out amid the rain of petals.

hunks.baseline: And so, the provincial martial family that had once been slowly fading, its glory behind it, had become stronger than ever by uniting as one.

hunks.baseline: The System window, far longer than usual and full of more changes than ever, ended as always with a wish for good fortune in Murim.

hunks.baseline: And yet that was the only thing that left me uneasy, even in the peace that had finally arrived.
